notes.title: Little Legend - Pre-Alpha Demo Footage
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

The last few months were focused on the creation of [b]a tutorial[/b] introducing the player to the basic game mechanics.

Here is the video :
[previewyoutube=q7PXDfmsKgM;full][/previewyoutube]

In this tutorial, the goal is to reach the Chasm in the Clouds by progressing through a lush forest, ancient ruins and caves.
Doing so, the main character, [b][i]Pimpim[/i][/b], will encounter a few creatures against which she will use her magic abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34320554/129fc1605a895477db5726b178f91328c650b469.jpg[/img]

Note that [b]her magic abilities are offensive but not destructive[/b], meaning the creatures that face her become neutral and ignore her for a time after being hit.

[olist]
[*] [b][i]Pulse[/i][/b] creates a shock wave which pushes objects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34320554/cf43f103aca3cf43f6a377e844604e25a3300f87.gif[/img]

[*] [b][i]Sphere[/i][/b] gives you the ability to summon solid spheres of energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34320554/b689930560feb6f14206349cdacdd19b50a32e19.gif[/img]

[*] [b][i]Swap[/i][/b] lets you switch places with an object.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34320554/dc6e2b523244a2398f2fc1e1df25494f3816e824.gif[/img]
[/olist]
By combining these spells together the player will able to discover new ways to explore the world, solve puzzles and fight enemies.

_

[b]We are currently working on a second demo.[/b]
If you want to get updated on our progress, feel free to come chat with us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/b6bBRaG] Discord [/url][/b] and [b][url=twitter.com/LittleLegendDev] Twitter [/url][/b].

[i]Thank you![/i]

Make sure to add Little Legend to your Wish list!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/987310/Little_Legend/
